title: 2022-12-08 DevOps Community Meeting
content:
Date

8th of December 2022

Participants

Goals

  • Roadmap overview

    • Akamai as a PR environment

  • General discussion - Q & A

Discussion topics

Time

Item

Presenter

Notes

5-10 mins

Welcome

  • Any updates in team contacts?

DevOps Community - IPEX DevOps - Confluence (atlassian.net)

MoM:

IPEX DevOps team will start using Slack release channel, https://i-p-e-x.slack.com/archives/C04DQ3G1QB0

10-20 min

Akamai as PR environment

&

HSD & Kvadrat talk about their experiences using Akamai for their pull-request environments.

MoMs:

Advantages is that we test in same environment as in production. Same performance and same administration.

Both HSD and Kvadrat will implement retention mgmt, inter-ikea/cbf-re-ipex-devops-akamai-file-retention-management (github.com)

Kvadrat has enabled SSO. If you don not need to show application for users outside Inter IKEA just send request to IPEX DevOps Team to enable for your AoA.

will publish scripts for generating test harness etc as package in Azure Artifacts.

HSD have drastically shortened change lead time by testing in cte.ikeadt, testing PRs automatically. Merged PR is released via workflow after final verification.

HSD have started using Vite | Next Generation Frontend Tooling (vitejs.dev) with good experiences and as well IPEX Gallery is using it.

3 min

IPEX Way Sonarqube

There is a new quality profile in town!

MoM:

Showed how to enable IPEX Way in Sonaqube. Now contains all rules available. If you use and think rule should be disabled, please notify IPEX DevOps Team . will investigate rule set on project level and SonarLint Integration | SonarQube.

7 min

POC of PACT-test

Findings in the POC using PACT-test in Kompis and DEXF.
PACT findings

MoM:

TLDR we will not start using PACT at the moment.

2 min

Push for the common feed from Azure

Why you should use the common feed in your repo.

MoM:

Use common - Azure Artifacts as your feed to make it easier for people outside team to build you application!

5-10 min
